newsitem.title: INDIA: Unit Trust selling drives down Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Unit Trust selling drives down Delhi shares.

text.p: Heavy selling by domestic financial institution Unit Trust of India (UTI) pushed down share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange in early trade on Thursday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index was 3.63 points lower at 755.36 points after 30 minutes of trade.
"Persistent selling by Unit Trust of India to raise funds to distribute a dividend to its unit holders has dampened the market sentiment," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
Unit Trust of India is the country's largest financial institution.
Reliance Industries fell 1.00 rupee to 282.30 on institutional selling, brokers said.
State Bank of India slipped 0.65 rupee to 301.15.

TELCO, which had been in the spotlight after announcing stronger-than-expected results, shed 1.45 rupees to 394.50 on profit-taking. TELCO's 1996/97 net profit increased to 7.62 billion rupees from 5.30 billion in the previous year.
